The narrower water ending has a more continuous creek outline than V1's broad leaf-like patch.

Shoreline remains simplified, and upstream walls, bare surrounding slopes, original crowns and forest density are outside this delivered scope.
Cold, low-quality and night candidate comparisons and a continuous LOD traversal have not yet run.
